summary: Standard Lithium filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a Canadian material change report) disclosing that Smackover Lithium, its partnership with Equinor, amended its binding offtake agreement with Trafigura Trading for the South West Arkansas Project. The amendment adds an option, at Smackover's election, for up to 4,000 t/yr of battery-quality lithium carbonate atop the initial 8,000 t/yr take-or-pay commitment, lifting maximum volume to 12,000 t/yr over the 10-year term; pricing remains confidential. Combined with LG Energy Solution's 8,000 t/yr, commitments reach 20,000 t of 22,500 t nameplate. Watch the ~$1.1 billion debt financing with three export credit agencies and the targeted year-end FID.
